channels.name: Sublime Package Control
channels.instructions: Review package-control.json as the package entry for repository/l.json in wbond/package_control_channel. Commit native scheme files at living-code-theme/sublime's root and create a matching v-prefixed semver tag. Package Control uses repository/tag archives, not an uploaded .sublime-package. The latter is a native manual-install artifact. Submit a human-reviewed upstream PR; packaging opens none.
